scope: Local concept at one existing fastener; source bodies cropped. Not a full gun revision or released machining design.
screw: Metal M3x35, unchanged nominal length; head moved 1.5mm rearward by proposed bearing stack.
check_notes: 5mm entry depth includes source entry chamfer; full-thread effective engagement and strength must be verified. Thread helix omitted. Sleeve ends at grounded-body exit; main PTFE bore provides remaining insulation toward live spacer.

contacts.a: Live steel spacer / original tapped bore

limitations: Alumina grade, tolerances, seat flatness, ceramic stress, preload, RF clearance, thermal expansion and shielding need engineering verification. Main PTFE seal ring remains loaded; this does not eliminate its creep. All twelve locations require full-assembly checks before implementation. Ceramic tube is not a threaded fastener.
